def process(suppression_costs) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = suppression_costs.copy()
    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)
    df['Acres'] = df['Acres'].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    df['Total'] = df['Total'].str.replace('$', '').str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    return df[['Year', 'Acres', 'Total']]
